stop_new.description: D-33: raised trailing stop (never below current) for TIGHTEN_STOP

scale_shares.description: D-33: shares to sell at this target for SCALE_OUT

committee_read.description: D-34: the committee's held-position verdict; the PM decides partial-vs-run from it

data_anchors.description: D-20: the numbers behind the action (unrealised, distance-to-stop, R-multiple, mp_state, etc.) so the PM sees why
D-20 anti-black-box: the decisive field values behind this idea, from committee data_anchors — the PM's numeric anchor to decide on

lens_readings.description: D-20: when the Detect lens nominated or flagged this name, its ACTUAL readings (lens_positive, lens_warnings, runner_setup/conviction, premove_setup/conviction) shown explicitly — the lens never surfaces a name as a black box

watch_table.x_note: D-20: each watch-table row must carry the data anchor that surfaced it (nomination_count, which voices, and the 2-3 field values behind it) — a watched name the PM can't see the data for is a black box

hedge.x_note: BL-007: the premarket hedge assessment output. Phase 1 = coverage matrix (beta-adjusted exposure vs SRM/macro posture); Phase 2 (only if coverage short) = the recommended put-spread structure from hedge_engine.py. Null/absent when position_count < 4 (skip rule) or coverage is adequate.

posture.description: macro/SRM posture the coverage was assessed against

recommended_structure.description: the chosen put-spread (legs, cost, coverage-to-cost) when Phase 2 ran
